description: This file contains Bash shell script functions and variables that serve as helpers for managing and interacting with the OpenClaw project via Docker. It includes commands for starting, stopping, configuring, and maintaining the OpenClaw environment, as well as utility functions for user interaction and UI access.

methods.name: _clr_cmd
methods.description: Prints styled command output in green and bold.

methods.name: _cmd
methods.description: Prints inline command prompts in green and bold.

methods.name: _clawdock_filter_warnings
methods.description: Filters out specific warning lines from command outputs.

methods.name: _clawdock_trim_quotes
methods.description: Removes surrounding quotes from a string.

methods.name: _clawdock_mask_value
methods.description: Redacts sensitive values, replacing them with placeholders depending on length.

methods.name: _clawdock_read_config_dir
methods.description: Reads the ClawDock config directory from the config file.

methods.name: _clawdock_ensure_dir
methods.description: Ensures CLAWDOCK_DIR is set and points to a valid directory, attempting auto-detection or user prompts if necessary.

methods.name: _clawdock_compose
methods.description: Runs docker compose commands with appropriate YAML files.

methods.name: _clawdock_read_env_token
methods.description: Reads the OpenClaw gateway token from the environment file.
